support_spans: Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)

contradict_spans: No improvements over 1 year with previous treatments for joint symptoms
Normal results for: C-reactive protein, anticyclic citrullinated peptide
candidates.why: The presence of swollen and painful joints, significantly elevated rheumatoid factor, and bone erosions on imaging suggests rheumatoid arthritis, but the lack of response to treatment and normal CRP and anti-CCP levels are contradictory.
